Query the Ensembl REST API

Source: R/analysis_information.R
queryEnsembl.Rd

Query the Ensembl REST API

Usage

queryEnsembl(path, query, grch37 = TRUE)

Arguments

path

Character: API path

query

Character: API query

grch37

Boolean: query the Ensembl GRCh37 API? if FALSE, query the most recent API

Value

Parsed response or NULL if no response

Examples

path  <- "overlap/region/human/7:140424943-140624564"
query <- list(feature = "gene")
psichomics:::queryEnsembl(path, query, grch37 = TRUE)
#>   canonical_transcript       end              id version seq_region_name

#> 2    ENST00000605989.1 140583978 ENSG00000271932       1               7

#> 1          BRAF        GRCh37 ENSG00000157764     -1
#> 2            U6        GRCh37 ENSG00000271932      1
#>                            logic_name        biotype
#> 1 ensembl_havana_gene_homo_sapiens_37 protein_coding
#> 2               ncrna_homo_sapiens_37          snRNA
#>                                                                   description

#>   feature_type     start         source

#> 2         gene 140583872        ensembl

query <- list(expand=1)
psichomics:::queryEnsembl(path, query, grch37 = TRUE)
